entry.name: StripWidth
entry.label: Width of the stage strip in logical pixels

entry.name: MaxVisibleStages
entry.label: Maximum number of stages shown in the strip

entry.name: HidingStrategy
entry.label: How windows outside the active stage are hidden (0 = minimize, 1 = hidden virtual desktop)

entry.name: AutoSwitchOnFocus
entry.label: Switch to a window's stage when it gets focus from elsewhere

entry.name: MaximizedPolicy
entry.label: What to do with maximized or tiled windows under the strip (0 = shrink, 1 = offset, 2 = leave them and let the strip slide away)

entry.name: KeepWindowsClear
entry.label: Move windows so they don't sit under the strip

entry.name: GroupByClass
entry.label: New windows join the stage their application was grouped into

entry.name: ShowStripOnStart
entry.label: Show the strip when the script starts
